programDescription: A 4-week hypertrophy and strength program designed to build muscle, improve athletic power, and enhance movement quality. Features progressive overload with compound lifts at 60-75% max, explosive plyometrics, and comprehensive mobility work. 3 days per week: Lower Body Monday, Upper Body Wednesday, Power Friday.
targetAudience: Intermediate to advanced athletes seeking muscle growth and athletic performance

warmUp.name: Hypertrophy Warm-Up
warmUp.description: Prepare muscles and joints for high-volume training

steps.name: Light Cardio

steps.name: Activation
steps.cue: Band pull-aparts (15), glute bridges (10), bodyweight squats (10)

coolDown.name: Hypertrophy Cool-Down
coolDown.description: Promote recovery and maintain flexibility after volume work

steps.name: Light Movement
steps.cue: Easy walk or bike to flush muscles

exercises.name: Hip Flexors

exercises.name: Hamstrings

exercises.name: Quads

exercises.name: Lats

steps.name: Breathing Reset
steps.cue: Lie on back, 4-count inhale, 6-count exhale, let muscles relax completely

optionalAddOn.name: Foam Rolling
optionalAddOn.cue: Target muscles worked in session - slow rolling, pause on tender spots

activeRecovery.name: Active Recovery Day
activeRecovery.description: Light movement to promote muscle recovery between training days

steps.name: Light Cardio
steps.cue: Easy walk, bike, or swim - keep HR in Zone 1-2

steps.name: Full Body Foam Rolling
steps.cue: Quads, hamstrings, glutes, lats, thoracic spine
steps.goal: Release myofascial tension and improve tissue quality

detailedSteps.technique: Face down, roll hip to knee, rotate leg in/out
Sit on roller, stack legs for more pressure
Cross ankle over knee, lean into tight side
Side-lying, arm overhead, roll armpit to mid-rib
Hands behind head, extend over roller at tight spots

steps.name: Mobility Flow
steps.cue: Cat-cow, 90/90 hip switches, thoracic rotations, shoulder dislocates
steps.goal: Restore range of motion and maintain movement quality

detailedSteps.name: Cat-Cow
detailedSteps.technique: Sync breath with movement, slow and controlled

detailedSteps.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
detailedSteps.technique: Keep chest tall, pause 2s each position

detailedSteps.name: Thoracic Rotations
detailedSteps.technique: Quadruped position, hand behind head, rotate to ceiling

detailedSteps.name: Shoulder Dislocates
detailedSteps.technique: Wide grip on band, control through full arc

exercises.name: Piriformis Stretch
exercises.instruction: Figure-4 position, gentle pressure on knee
exercises.definition: Deep hip rotator stretch preventing tightness and improving hip mobility
detailedInstructions: Lie on back with both knees bent, feet flat
Cross one ankle over opposite knee (figure-4 position)
Thread hands through and interlace behind supporting thigh
Gently pull supporting leg toward chest
Keep head relaxed on floor, breathe deeply
To increase stretch: push crossed knee away from body
exercises.trainerNotes: This stretch targets the piriformis and deep hip external rotators. If you feel nerve symptoms (tingling/numbness), ease off immediately.

exercises.name: Stagger Stance Deadlift
exercises.instruction: Slight stagger with back foot on toe, hinge at hips maintaining neutral spine
exercises.definition: Semi-unilateral hip hinge targeting posterior chain with added stability challenge

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instruction: Half-kneeling position, squeeze glute of back leg, lean forward slightly
exercises.definition: Essential stretch for hip flexor length and pelvic positioning
detailedInstructions: Kneel on back knee (use pad for comfort)
Front foot flat, knee over ankle at 90°
Tuck pelvis under (posterior tilt) to flatten low back
Squeeze glute of back leg hard
Lean forward slightly while maintaining pelvic tuck
You should feel stretch in front of back hip, not low back
exercises.trainerNotes: The key is squeezing the glute—this puts the hip flexor on stretch. Without the glute squeeze, you're just arching your back.
